headline: Patent pending. The first purchase order is out. New deposits are paused while pricing is updated.

stages.title: Parts on order
stages.note: The first purchase order went out August 20 - the batch's balloon wheels. The full parts list is being finalized now, and the remaining orders go out as it locks. Frame fabrication is next.

stages.title: Deposits paused
stages.note: The first three build slots are reserved. New deposits are paused while pricing is updated. Existing deposits are unchanged: each holds its numbered build slot and stays fully refundable until you approve your final invoice.

stages.title: In production
stages.note: Frames welded at a professional fabrication shop, then every cart is built by John in slot order - same hands that built the original cart. Each one gets a serial number and a recorded test before it leaves.

stages.title: Delivering
stages.note: Hand-delivered by John, Maine to New Jersey, in build-slot order.

footnote: This page is updated when something real happens, and only then.
